purpose: W-A repeatability streak under the declared load and test order

declaredLoad.declaration: four busy-spinner Node processes (tests/system/udg-003-phase-3/wa-streak.ts generates them; each spins on Math.sqrt until killed) run alongside every streak iteration
declaredLoad.why: the hosted job runs on a shared 4-vCPU runner and the failures arrived while the job was heavy. Four spinners on the implementer's 18-core container reproduce sustained scheduling pressure on the single-threaded probe without invalidating the measurement environment.

machineClass.nodeVersion: v24.22.3 (the implementer container; the repository pins 24.22.2 and the authoritative first-attempt hosted run executes on the pinned toolchain)
machineClass.note: declared honestly: this is not the pinned Node and not the runner's core count, which is why the rule is ten local passes AND a first-attempt hosted green on the exact submitted commit

declaredLoad.saturationProfileReportedSeparately: an environment-saturated profile (one spinner per core, 18/18) is reported as defect WA-3 in the W-A diagnosis record: it flips the impairment probe's own environment controls and is disclosed as environment-invalidating, not as the declared streak load. A streak run in an environment the probe itself declares invalid would be a green that means nothing.

declaredOrder.declaration: the full `pnpm test` order as resolved by the pinned `vitest.config.ts` — `fileParallelism: false`, `maxWorkers: 1`, include `tests/**/*.test.ts` — with the two affected cases running inside it, never isolated
declaredOrder.whyTheWholeFileOrder: the contention under test is the suite's own serial execution: the probe writes the artefact the two cases read, and the accepted harness is polled while the rest of the suite competes for the same event loop. Isolating the two cases would remove the environment that the hosted failures arrived in.
